summary.prose: Build one Milkdown scratchpad editor on the existing Markdown TextDocument, with remembered lock controls and an explicit selection Send action. The work adds a versioned synchronization and recovery bridge, integrates native save/undo and portable images, then replaces all legacy document-channel consumers together. Browser, Markdown-corpus and real VS Code qualification are required before validation can pass.

tasks.title: Stable scratchpad identity and validated editor protocol
tasks.summary: Add shared sc1 home/basename identity and read-only store resolver without s7 metadata or workspace inference. Define closed runtime-validated session/sequence/base-version/digest/edit-parent, receipt/ack/conflict/command/asset unions; ordinary messages capped at 2 MiB and notes at 1 MiB UTF-8.

tasks.title: Markdown fidelity admission and source preservation
tasks.summary: Opening/parsing/selecting/locking produces zero edits; retain original source bytes. Implement parse/serialize/parse semantic checks and raw fingerprints for front matter, HTML/comments, code/diagram fences and literal custom links. Unknown constructs require verified exact opaque preservation or refuse mutation with original/draft intact. Use corpus fixtures to distinguish intentional supported edits from unrelated loss; minimal diff alone is insufficient.

tasks.title: Serialize versioned minimal TextDocument edits
tasks.summary: Implement one per-document queue shared across panes, one awaited apply at a time and minimal contiguous WorkspaceEdit. Every local change reports latest draft even while apply pending; coalesce superseded snapshots, validate accepted base/identified parents and match self-origin change events. Reject stale/cross-session/conflicting duplicate messages; suppress echo; old ack never overwrites newer typing, external unmatched change freezes mutation and retains competing text.

tasks.title: Persist pending drafts and handle editor recovery
tasks.summary: Persist bounded latest received/unapplied per-document draft before receipt; clear only committed or explicitly discarded. Dispose must not cancel accepted safe edit or delete recovery; reopening/reload exposes recovery without automatic overwrite. Storage/apply/receipt failures remain visible and never falsely claim saved state; no s7 lifecycle metadata.

tasks.title: Build the single-pane renderer and remembered lock controls
tasks.summary: Create proposed Milkdown webview with explicit setReadonly, initial locked preference, pane-local toggle and remembered future-pane mode. Independent accessible Send-only selection tooltip remains usable locked; selection-only transactions emit no edits and hide mutation tools while locked. Renderer uses the new bridge and preserves newer draft on old ack; initialization/unsupported-size errors preserve source and offer explicit same-file text fallback.

tasks.title: Bind the custom editor to native document lifecycle
tasks.summary: Register scoped insrc.scratchpad.editor with CustomTextEditorProvider and inject host APIs through activation; reject unrelated or refused URIs. Remove library history plugin array before creation and rebind keys/actions to correct-document host undo/redo after draining. Standard Save drains; onWillSave is best effort only; autosave may save earlier canonical state while pending text remains recoverable. Broadcast host/undo/external changes without secondary history or echo. Dispose listeners/sessions cleanly and support multiple groups; no private native editor APIs or native-save O_NOFOLLOW claim.

tasks.title: Route explicit selection Send into the chat composer
tasks.summary: Click/keyboard activation captures immutable pane/session/draft-sequence/document-version and exact plain selected text with paragraph boundaries before focus changes. Drain captured sequence, validate compatible source, cap at 65,536 UTF-8 bytes including ellipsis and use reveal/ready/disposed/insert route once without submission. Selection alone does nothing; incompatible stale source retains snapshot and reports retry, never silently recaptures.

tasks.title: Support portable image and workspace link authoring
tasks.summary: Override Crepe inline/block upload for paste/drop and host-chosen image insertion; validate asset root/type, 10 MiB image bound and exclusive names. Persist relative Markdown paths; display through proxyDomURL/asWebviewUri only, never save blob:/vscode-webview: URLs. Provide workspace link/image pickers and URL-as-link paste in the same pane; failed/cancelled upload inserts no broken reference or remote call.

tasks.title: Coordinate safe deletion and list refresh
tasks.summary: Both browse/chat deletion use one async exact-URI operation: serialize/drain, inspect all groups, cancel dirty/pending/recovery, await clean targeted close and recheck/revalidate before guarded unlink. Close cancellation leaves file; unlink failure attempts reopen and reports failure; never close unrelated tabs or promise cross-window exclusion. One scoped disposable save listener coalesces browse/menu refresh, catches failures independently and never opens closed UI; creation/deletion refresh same boundary.

tasks.title: Switch all consumers and retire the legacy document channel
tasks.summary: Atomically wire open/new/async delete/refreshList in panels, scratch host and activation; creation versus open failures are reported separately. richEditor defaults true, off explicitly opens same file in text editor; preserve browse UI, capUtf8, six chat intents, names and guarded store APIs. Remove textarea renderer/bootstrap, old save/saved/dirty/readiness/content protocol, onDocMessage/replySaved/generation/showingId/invalidateId and obsolete callback/test consumers together; migrate fakes/type shims.

tasks.title: Record performance, packaging and final acceptance evidence
tasks.summary: Measure 1 MiB UTF-8 note/boundaries and 2 MiB bridge limits on a recorded reference host: <=150 ms median keystroke-to-render and <=1 s p95 host ack. If unmet, validation fails; a reduced support bound needs a tracked design revision and fresh approval before acceptance. Verify production VSIX includes browser JS/CSS and retains Node/CJS activation/uninstall packaging; no remote assets/AI calls or accidental Markdown-wide takeover. Map actual evidence to ac1-ac4 and every task; preserve failures/unavailable tests honestly, do not mark BUILD valid until mandatory checks pass; update relevant design visuals if implementation changes interactions.

testStrategyCoverage.lldStrategyItem: Deterministic identity, URI/type/symlink refusal, note/image/message bounds and no-op-on-open guards.
One-in-flight/queued-descendant behavior, duplicate/stale/cross-pane messages, self echo versus external change and late acknowledgements.
Dirty/recovery/cancelled/failed deletion, created-but-open-failed reporting, save refresh/disposal and bounded composer insertion.
Published 7.23.0 local bundle under production CSP, setReadonly/mode preference and independent Send tooltip with keyboard focus preservation.
Remove Milkdown history provider/commands/keymap; bind host-targeted undo/redo, drain and broadcast without loops.

Parse/serialize/edit corpus: headings, tight/loose lists, tables, links/images, escaping, front matter, HTML/comments, Unicode, CRLF, fenced code/diagrams and literal custom links. Assert original unchanged on open and no unknown-content loss on supported edits.
Asset onUpload/proxyDomURL keeps portable relative source paths; failures never insert transient/broken URLs.
Static/typecheck migration: no legacy document protocol/method consumers; six chat intents remain.
Real .md open/edit/save/dirty/undo/redo/revert, native autosave and external edits in same and second windows.
Close/reload while draft receipt/apply/ack is delayed; prove recovery without false saved state or draft loss.
Multiple groups/panes, remembered lock, locked selection, select->click Send with chat closed/ready/disposed, and no automatic submission.
Real image paste/drop, URL paste, workspace link/image insertion, CSP/offline operation and error paths.

Budget: 1 MiB UTF-8 note and boundaries; responsiveness target <=150 ms median keystroke-to-render and <=1 s p95 host acknowledgement on a recorded reference host, with a smaller supported bound or explicit design revision if unmet.
